summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only testing for Epic E2 voucher system and cart persistence regression fix. All 10 test scenarios passed successfully. Backend was not tested (already passed 100% in iteration_4).
passed_tests: Cart persistence after full reload (REGRESSION FIX verified) - cart item count maintained after F5
Voucher Center rendering - 5 voucher cards with apply buttons displayed
Cart voucher apply via input (WELCOME10) - discount Rp 74.500 (10% of 745.000) from server
Cart voucher remove - discount returns to Rp 0, chip disappears
Cart voucher apply via card (AMBEROUD15) - discount Rp 111.750 (15% of 745.000) from server
Ineligible voucher display - GRANDLAUNCH shows 'Min. belanja Rp 500.000' when subtotal < 500.000, apply button disabled
Checkout page loads without redirect (redirect race fix verified) - _hydrated flag prevents premature redirect
Checkout voucher apply (WELCOME10) - discount Rp 49.500 (10% of 495.000) from server
Free shipping voucher (ONGKIRGRATIS) - discount Rp 22.000 equals shipping cost, total changes correctly on apply/remove
Voucher page (/voucher) - renders with voucher center and 5 voucher cards
